summary: Add EvaluateFalseTransformer.visit_Compare to construct unevaluated Eq, Ne, Lt, Le, Gt, and Ge relations, recursively preserving operands and combining chained comparisons with And. Leave non-relational comparison operators on the existing generic path. Add regressions for all six operators, numeric and symbolic operands, nested arithmetic and list expressions, conjunctions and chains, ordinary evaluated behavior, membership and identity. Reproduced original parse_expr('1 < 2', evaluate=False) failure and confirmed the new regression failed before implementation. Public parser and sympify suites passed: 75 passed, 5 skipped, 2 expected failures. Reviewed final diff.
